acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Data were acquired in a data-dependent manner using a fixed cycle time of 2 s, an expected peak width of 15 s, and a default charge state of +2.

All spectra were acquired using an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer controlled by Xcalibur 3.0 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and operated in data-dependent acquisition mode using an SPS-MS3 workflow.

collision_energy.evidence: Fragmentation spectra were acquired with a resolution of 15,000, a normalized collision energy of 30%, an AGC target of 300%, a first mass of 110 Th, and a maximum fill time of 25 ms for a single microscan.
ITMS2 spectra were collected with an AGC target of 10,000, max injection time of 70 ms, and CID collision energy of 35%.
Precursors were fragmented by high-energy collision dissociation at a normalized collision energy of 60% to ensure maximal TMT reporter ion yield.
